details: Bitcoin has experienced a notable dip, falling below $82,000. This decline is attributed to a broader negative market sentiment, influenced by surging oil prices and rising US Treasury yields. Adding to the bearish pressure, Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded their most significant daily outflow since June, with approximately $487 million withdrawn.
title: Bitcoin Faces Pressure Amid Market Downturn and ETF Outflows

details: Ripple's prime brokerage division, Ripple Prime, is making inroads into traditional finance by offering swap financing for leveraged Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). This move positions Ripple to compete with established banks in the lucrative and balance-sheet-intensive derivatives market, building on its 2025 acquisition of Hidden Road.
title: Ripple's Prime Brokerage Arm Challenges Wall Street in ETF Market

details: Thailand is preparing to allow the trading of spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), with implementation slated for October 16. This regulatory approval signifies growing mainstream acceptance and institutional integration of major cryptocurrencies within the Southeast Asian nation.
title: Thailand to Launch Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs

details: Tether, the issuer of the largest stablecoin USDT, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Central Bank of Kazakhstan. The collaboration aims to explore the potential development of a stablecoin backed by the Kazakhstani Tenge, indicating increasing sovereign interest in stablecoin technology for national financial infrastructure.
title: Tether Explores Tenge Stablecoin with Kazakhstan's Central Bank

details: While Bitcoin has seen a downturn, certain altcoins, notably Solana (SOL) and Dogecoin (DOGE), have demonstrated significant positive performance. Solana surged by 9% and Dogecoin by 8% within the last 24 hours, suggesting a rotation of capital and strong individual momentum for these cryptocurrencies despite the broader market's struggles.
title: Altcoins Solana and Dogecoin Show Strong Gains Amidst Market Dip
